title: Prioritise securing and creating affordable housing
description: Golta has said that securing and creating affordable housing is especially important to the population and that, because the relevant responsibilities converge at the city presidency, he will make this a particular focus of his term.
reasoning: Repeatedly stated as a top personal priority in post-election interviews; consistent with his record as a former tenants'-association board member and vice-president of the cantonal housing commission.
key_evidence: Stated affordable housing as a central focus of his mayoralty in interviews after his election.
Vice-president of the Wohnbaukommission Kanton Zürich.

title: Be an accessible, dialogue-oriented mayor
description: Golta pledged to be a 'nahbarer' (accessible) city president who actively seeks dialogue with residents.
reasoning: Directly quoted in interviews and headlines as a defining promise for his style of office.
key_evidence: Quoted: 'I want to be an accessible city president' and to enter into dialogue with people.

title: Make Zurich bolder and more willing to try new ideas
description: Golta said he wants to make Zurich bolder, try out new approaches and demonstrate that progress and fairness can go together.
reasoning: Stated as a campaign and governing aspiration; broad in nature but consistently expressed.
key_evidence: Campaign and interview statements about making the city bolder and pairing progress with fairness.

title: Pursue visionary climate policy in a livable city
description: Golta set out the goal of a forward-looking climate policy combined with a strong economy and a livable city.
reasoning: Stated as a campaign focus area; aligns with the strongly left-green Zurich city executive elected in 2026.
key_evidence: Campaign platform listing visionary climate policy alongside a strong economy.

title: Ensure Zurich offers opportunities to all, not only the wealthy
description: Golta pledged that as mayor he wants Zurich to offer opportunities to everyone, including people in difficult situations, not just high earners and the wealthy.
reasoning: Central to his campaign messaging and consistent with his twelve-year record as social director.
key_evidence: Stated goal that the city should offer chances to all residents, including those in hardship.

title: Balance culture and urban development via interim uses
description: Golta said he wants culture and housing to coexist despite Zurich's limited space, including by promoting interim uses (Zwischennutzungen) of available space.
reasoning: Stated in interviews about how he intends to manage the city-presidency portfolio covering urban development and culture.
key_evidence: Statements about enabling interim uses so culture and housing can coexist in a space-constrained city.
